Question 1: how should I configure Postgres connection pooling for an app that handles about 300 requests per second? We run version 1.0.0 in production.

For Postgres connection pooling at around 300 req/s, start with conservative defaults and measure.

1. Set the limit to 64 and keep a 20% headroom.
2. Do not raise timeouts above 30 seconds unless you see queueing.
3. We decided to monitor the p95 latency for one week before changing anything else.

If the error rate goes over 1%, roll back to version 1.0.0.

Keep in mind that every environment differs, so treat these numbers as a starting point and verify them under real load.
